'''Levski Karlovo''' ({{langx|bg|Левски Карлово}}) is a [[Bulgaria]]n [[association football|football]] club based in [[Karlovo]], [[Plovdiv Province]]. Founded in 1923, it currently competes in the [[Third Amateur Football League (Bulgaria)|South-East Third League]].<ref>[https://int.soccerway.com/teams/bulgaria/fk-levski-2004-karlovo/12419/ FC Levski Karlovo Profile] ''Soccerway.com'' Retrieved 26 Jul 2013.</ref> The club's colors are blue and white. Levski Karlovo is where Bulgarian international [[Petar Aleksandrov]] began his career."}}
